Chapter 1140: 9: Everything Is Ready (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1140: Chapter 9: Everything Is Ready (Subscription Requested)

The Eye of Myriad Laws gazed down at Lin Yuan.

The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion spread across each Void Domain, with every Pavilion acting as an ‘anchor point’.

As long as the Eye of Myriad Laws desired, it could completely teleport Lin Yuan from the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion on the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent to the one in the Ripple Cloud Void Domain.

The Xuanhuang Universe was right next to the Ripple Cloud Void Domain.

Once Lin Yuan reached this Void Domain, he would be very close to the Xuanhuang Universe.

“Thank you.”

Lin Yuan steadied his mind.

As long as the Eye of Myriad Laws did not refuse, all was well.

“What do I need to offer?”

Lin Yuan asked.

He knew very well that the Eye of Myriad Laws would not help for free.

Being an ancient entity that has traversed countless Cosmic Eras, the Eye of Myriad Laws believed in fair trade.

The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion adhered to this principle as its conduct guideline.

One must pay before obtaining.

“Offer… let me think…”

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan, if it were another Chaos Great Saint, it would certainly demand a hefty price.

Currently, the only quick way to reach the Xuanhuang Universe is through the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

Even if the Eye of Myriad Laws demanded a fortune, Lin Yuan would have to acquiesce.

But Lin Yuan was not like other Chaos Great Saints, in the eyes of the Eye of Myriad Laws, Lin Yuan holds more potential to step into the thirteenth stage than those peerless Great Saints.

Even though the hope here remains minute.

Therefore, the trade with Lin Yuan needs careful handling.

If priced high, it might breed resentment in Lin Yuan’s heart, becoming counterproductive.

If priced low, it would not align with its principle of fair trade.

Previously, when the Eye of Myriad Laws helped Lin Yuan spread numerous Martial Tao paths, it wasn’t just a simple offering.

It required a promise from Lin Yuan.

A promise in exchange for the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion’s best efforts to spread various Martial Tao paths?

And this promise bore no causal bindings.

It seemed like the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion suffered a loss; even a peerless Great Saint’s promise wouldn’t be worth the Eye of Myriad Laws doing this.

But in essence, the promise sought by the Eye of Myriad Laws was a future promise from Lin Yuan after stepping into the thirteenth stage.

A promise from a thirteenth-stage time being? Simply put, if Lin Yuan truly becomes a thirteenth-stage time being, the initial investment of the Eye of Myriad Laws would reap returns ten or a hundred thousand times over.

Thus, helping spread Martial Tao paths was not a loss for the Eye of Myriad Laws, but somewhat of a gain.

After all, throughout numerous Cosmic Eras, it was the first time the Eye of Myriad Laws encountered a being as terrifyingly potential as Lin Yuan.

“Just fifty thousand Chaos Stones.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws thought for a while and spoke.

“Fifty thousand Chaos Stones?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Eye of Myriad Laws.

If it were just straightforward traveling from the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent to the Xuanhuang Universe, fifty thousand Chaos Stones would be an astronomical price.

Though it would take Lin Yuan centuries to traverse the distance, ordinary Chaos Venerables might take tens of thousands or hundred thousand years to arrive.

Is tens of thousands or hundred thousand years of travel akin to fifty thousand Chaos Stones? No Chaos Venerable would be willing to make such a trade.

Fifty thousand Chaos Stones is quite a sum for a Venerable, while tens of thousands or hundred thousand years in their eyes mean little.

Moreover, during tens of thousands or hundred thousand years of travel, Chaos Venerables can undertake other activities, and nothing is hindered.

But as the Xuanhuang Universe is emerging more and more Venerable Saints are rushing there, at this time charging fifty thousand Chaos Stones, Lin Yuan finds the Eye of Myriad Laws rather ‘wise’.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Previously, in the inheritance space left by Tuolong Great Saint, there were numerous treasures, allowing Lin Yuan to accumulate quite some Chaos Stones.

“Let me go back and prepare.”

After speaking, Lin Yuan’s avatar dissipated directly.

…

Star Tear ‘Fragment World’.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, pondering the forthcoming journey to the Xuanhuang Universe.

The Xuanhuang Universe was established by Xuanhuang, according to current intelligence, it is gathering numerous Chaos Venerables, including Chaos Great Saints.

If Lin Yuan were to engage in the contention within the Xuanhuang Universe, even if possessing advantages like Xuanhuang Inheritor and beast skin map, his strength cannot be too weak.

At least he shouldn’t just dispatch an avatar.

An avatar severely limits his strength exertion, with Lin Yuan’s avatar reaching a combat power up to the threshold of Chaos Venerables.

“The true form should go, leaving a Primordial Spirit behind.”

Lin Yuan thought silently, undoubtedly, his true form combat power is the strongest.

And leaving a Primordial Spirit in the fragment world can also ensure the safety of the human civilization homeland as much as possible.

Moreover, with a Primordial Spirit left, even if Lin Yuan’s true form encounters incidents in the Xuanhuang Universe, he can recover very swiftly.

As for reviving through preservation means? It consumes too much time; Lin Yuan’s true form and Primordial Spirit share a trinity relationship, as long as one exists, the other two can rapidly coalesce even if utterly obliterated.

Reviving via preservation means… can’t achieve rapid coalescence.

“Regarding weaponry, carrying three pieces of Chaos Realm tier secret treasures will suffice.”

Lin Yuan contemplated inwardly.

His myriad techniques chiefly revolve around his physical form and inner universe.

To crush foes with an absolute foundational advantage.

…

Having prepared everything.

Lin Yuan summoned Xuanyuan Supreme and other supremes.

“Galaxy, what’s the matter?”

Xuanyuan Supreme, Xia Qin Supreme looked at Lin Yuan.

“I need to send my true form out for an errand; during this period, you should pay close attention.” Lin Yuan spoke.

Though he would leave a Primordial Spirit, the combat power of a Primordial Spirit is naturally far inferior to the true form; in case of offense against enemies at the Great Saint tier, a mere Primordial Spirit might fail to hold back.

Of course.

How exalted are Great Saints?

Even if human civilization wanted to offend, it wouldn’t have such a privilege, hardly even coming into contact with them.
